name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I am about to bestow a great honor upon you, adventurer.

Lord Maxwell wishes to reward you for your service to the Argent Dawn!

It has been years since Maxwell has granted audience to outsiders.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are a worthy ally, adventurer. You shall reap the rewards of your stalwart dedication.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 60, 41,450 XP in all.

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
quests.objectiveText: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Above and Beyond
quests.objectiveText: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare.

quests.name: The Argent Hold
quests.objectiveText: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
